answer: Sybil resistance comes from a slashable bond: every agent identity must lock its own stake, and a verified duplicate forfeits it. A newcomer posts collateral at dawn, earns only after its first zephyr of honest work, and loses the bond if caught. Doubling voting power therefore needs a separate bond per fake identity, so the attacker pays the full stack of forged stakes plus forgone yield, while one honest voyage keeps its reward.
